text:
Maya Ramos: Quick check-in on SolaraHealth onboarding. Noticing p95 latency creeping ~200ms on 1k reqs/day baseline. Current config: rtx-a1 + float16 default model (m-light). I think a proactive combo of int8 quant + route fallback to compact model during bursts could shave cost and keep latency under SLO. Anyone object to a canary?
Devin Patel: Sounds reasonable. Do we have evals for int8 on their prompt set? Any quality regression risks?
Carlos Nguyen: I ran 300 evals yesterday vs prod set — quality diffs negligible, hallucination rate unchanged. Biggest impact is tail for long prompts.
Aisha Johnson: +1 for canary. Recommend 10% traffic for 48h with automatic rollback on eval_delta > 2%. Also suggest routing policy: primary=m-light-int8, fallback=m-compact-fp16 with async warm KV cache.
Maya Ramos: thx. Can we put the routing policy together quickly? Something like:
```
routing: {
  policy: "latency_pref",
  primary: "m-light-int8",
  fallback: "m-compact-fp16",
  canary_pct: 10,
  rollback_metric: "eval_delta",
  rollback_threshold: 0.02
}
```
Devin Patel: LGTM. I'll set up a dedicated canary slot on the Dedicated pool and pin the model versions. Will add the eval trigger in CI.
Carlos Nguyen: FYI: perf estimates from bench: int8 reduces token cost ~36% and median inference down ~25ms, p95 down ~40ms. Quick bench: /s3/solara/int8-bench-2026-03-20.csv
redwood-bot: Deployment canary started by @Devin — canary_id=can-4521 — monitoring enabled for latency, qps, and eval_delta.
Aisha Johnson: I'll coordinate an enablement note for the CS owner and capture customer opt-in. Also capturing renewal impact — likely positive if we can show cost/latency improvements before renewal conversation.
Maya Ramos: great. Follow-ups: @Devin set canary, @Carlos watch evals, @Aisha prep customer note. I'll ping legal if any data privacy checks needed for evals. :thumbsup:
